cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

mechanism: A copies a timing signal incorrectly and turns B correction into evidence of a repeated neglect pattern with escalating consequences.
confusable: D96 needs repeated pattern plus raised stakes, not simply D84 grudge.
comparison: Late dinners versus cancelled family visits.
seedUse: Keep B proposed repair reinterpreted as another cycle.
